finding.title: Buffer Overflow
finding.trigger: If int_type->name is longer than the buffer size allocated for it, a buffer overflow will occur.
finding.assumptions: The name of the constrained int type is obtained from user input or an external source and is not properly validated for length.

finding.title: Integer Overflow
finding.trigger: If the values of int_type->min_value or int_type->max_value exceed the range of the data type used to store them, an integer overflow will occur.
finding.assumptions: The minimum and maximum values are derived from user input or an external source and are not properly validated for range.

finding.title: OS Command Injection
finding.trigger: If the source_code contains malicious input that is interpreted as an OS command, it could lead to OS command injection.
finding.assumptions: The parse_constrained_int_type function executes external commands or interprets input in a way that could lead to command execution.

finding.title: Use After Free
finding.trigger: If int_type is used after it has been freed, a use after free vulnerability could occur.
finding.assumptions: The int_type structure is complex and may contain pointers that are freed but still used later.
